title: Micah Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Micah 4: the mountain of Yahweh's temple, swords beaten into plowshares, and the daughter of Zion.

questions.text: In the latter days, what will be established on the top of the mountains?
questions.explanation: Micah 4:1 says the mountain of Yahweh's temple will be established on the top of the mountains and exalted above the hills.

answers.text: The throne of the king of Babylon
The tower of the flock of Jerusalem
The house of the statutes of Omri

questions.text: What do the many nations say Yahweh will do for them when they go up to his mountain?
questions.explanation: In Micah 4:2 the nations say he will teach them of his ways, so that they walk in his paths.

answers.text: Hand them the spoil of war

questions.text: Where does the text say the law will go out from?
questions.explanation: Micah 4:2 says the law will go out of Zion, and Yahweh's word from Jerusalem.

questions.text: What will the peoples beat their swords into?
questions.explanation: Micah 4:3 says they will beat their swords into plowshares and will not learn war any more.

questions.text: Under what will every man sit, with no one to make him afraid?
questions.explanation: Micah 4:4 says they will sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree, and no one will make them afraid.

answers.text: Under the gate of his own city
Under the shade of a cedar tree
Under his vine and his fig tree
Under the roof of the king's house

questions.text: According to this chapter, what will Yahweh gather in that day?
questions.explanation: In Micah 4:6 Yahweh says he will assemble that which is lame and gather that which is driven away.

questions.text: Where will Yahweh reign over them forever?
questions.explanation: Micah 4:7 says Yahweh will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on, even forever.

questions.text: Where will the daughter of Zion come to, and there be rescued?
questions.explanation: Micah 4:10 says she will go out of the city, dwell in the field and come even to Babylon, and there she will be rescued.

questions.text: What do the nations assembled against her say?
questions.explanation: In Micah 4:11 the nations say, "Let her be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion."

questions.text: What will Yahweh make the horn of the daughter of Zion?
questions.explanation: In Micah 4:13 Yahweh says he will make her horn iron, so that she beats many peoples in pieces.
